clean_env_check.how: python3 -m venv + pip install --no-cache-dir aisef==1.7.1 from PUBLIC PyPI, run with cwd OUTSIDE the repository
clean_env_check.why_outside_the_repo: a stale gitignored aisef.egg-info at version 1.7.0 sits in the repo root; running python from there puts cwd on sys.path and importlib.metadata resolves that instead of the venv. It produced a false 1.7.0 reading earlier in this session.

v1_7_0_disposition: tag still on 966add6, never moved/deleted/recreated; never published to PyPI (HTTP 404). Preserved as evidence of the failed release attempt.
